sources.name: NBA Stats glossary
sources.finding: Pace is possessions per 48 minutes; offensive rating is points per 100 possessions; net rating is offensive minus defensive rating.

sources.name: NBA Stats FAQ
sources.finding: Pace changes raw per-game statistics; compare on a per-possession basis.

sources.name: NBA official injury reports
sources.finding: Teams submit participation statuses before games; reports are continually updated. No individual report snapshot is imported.

sources.name: NBA Stats games
sources.finding: Candidate source for completed game results; historical dataset has not been ingested or audited.

sources.name: Singapore National Council on Problem Gambling
sources.finding: Set a gambling budget and time/frequency limits; gambling involves risk.

strategies.name: Single-game side or total
strategies.signal: Estimate possession-adjusted scoring distribution; compare calibrated probability with offered implied probability after costs.
strategies.inputs: NBA pace, ratings, schedule, injury timestamp; independently licensed timestamped market odds
strategies.correlation: Not applicable for one outcome; model-feature dependencies must still be audited.
strategies.gate: Out-of-time calibration + positive net expected value + adequate sample + valid market snapshot

strategies.name: Cross-game parlay
strategies.signal: Estimate joint probability with simulation, not product of marginal probabilities unless independence is tested.
strategies.inputs: Verified single-leg models; simultaneous market quotes and settlement rules
strategies.correlation: Estimate pairwise outcome covariance and uncertainty from held-out games; joint dependency is not identified by a single correlation coefficient.
strategies.gate: All legs pass single-leg gate; joint model beats independent baseline and net offered payout threshold

strategies.name: Player prop combination
strategies.signal: Model minutes and per-minute production conditional on availability and rotation; simulate shared game environment.
strategies.inputs: NBA box scores and timestamped injury report; licensed prop lines and rules
strategies.correlation: Measure residual within-game correlation of minutes, pace and production; bootstrap by game/date.
strategies.gate: Report fresh at freeze time; calibrated joint probabilities and robust positive net EV

gates.name: Provenance
gates.rule: Every observation has official game ID, source URL, event timestamp and capture timestamp; missing facts stay blank.

gates.name: No leakage
gates.rule: Use only facts public before the quoted line was available; freeze training, validation and test chronologically.

gates.name: Probability quality
gates.rule: Compare log loss and Brier score against simple predeclared baselines; publish reliability bins and uncertainty intervals.

gates.name: Economic quality
gates.rule: Track settled ROI, net expected value and closing-line comparison with rules, voids and fees captured; no claim from backtest alone.

gates.name: Selection & safety
gates.rule: Reject stale quotes, unclear settlement, thin samples or missing injury snapshots; limit risk and never chase losses.

flags.item: Historical market prices and settlement terms
flags.reason: No official verified public bookmaker feed or license established. No odds, expected value or realized ROI can be calculated.
No timestamped paired outcome dataset has been collected; correlation values and leaderboards remain blank.
Official injury-report landing page is verified, but no timestamped player-level snapshot is imported. Do not assume current availability.
Uncertainty in sporting outcomes cannot be eliminated. Skill can only be evaluated via pre-registered, out-of-time calibration and repeated trials.
